text: D20 Tests encompass the three main d20 rolls of the game: ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. If something in the game affects D20 Tests, it affects all three of these rolls. The GM determines whether a D20 Test is warranted in a given circumstance. *See also* “Playing the Game” (“D20 Tests”).

master_decisions.prompt: Is a D20 Test warranted here?
